text:
cheng: heads up - ran the AWQ vs GPTQ bakeoff for mistral-3 on the CUDA21 stack + TRT-LLM plugin. AWQ has ~0.6% ppl regression versus GPTQ but only when running through TRT-LLM; native vLLM runs look fine. also saw a kernel assert during a fallback path. :thinking:
nisha: can you paste the minimal repro + logs?
samuel: copying logs below, reproduction command and quick notes. this happens on sequence lengths >1024 and with KV caching enabled.
samuel: repro (docker):
```
docker run --gpus all -it --rm 
  -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 
  -v $(pwd)/models:/models 
  redwood/trtllm:cuda21-2026-03 
  python3 run_quant_bake.py --model /models/mistral-3 --quant awq --seq-len 2048 --use-trtllm
```
samuel: truncated log (assert):
```
[TRTLLM] plugin_init: using plugin v0.9.3
trtllm_plugin.cu:452: void copy_kv_to_cache(...): Assertion `dst_idx < MAX_KV_SLOTS` failed.
Aborted (core dumped)
```
maria: hmm. that assert suggests an index wrapping when KV cache resizing happens during continuous batching. do you see it on CUDA20?
samuel: no, CUDA20 with same plugin is clean. also tried TRT-LLM with GPTQ quant -> clean. AWQ + vLLM fallback path triggers it.
leo: did you try disabling kernel fusion flags? last time fusion exposed a bounds-check regression on new cuda drivers.
samuel: yes, setting TRTLIM_DISABLE_KERNEL_FUSION=1 avoids the assert but ppl regression persists.
cheng: so two things: the assert (panic) seems fusion-related and only on AWQ path, and the accuracy delta appears only when serving via trtllm (native vllm/generic runtime fine).
nisha: can you attach the exact model checkpoint hash + AWQ params (group size, bits, perchannel)? need to reproduce locally.
samuel: model hash: 9f2a7b3e, AWQ params: 4-bit, group=64, qtype=awq, perchannel=true.
maria: interesting — AWQ packer emits a slightly different ordering of QKV scales which could interact with a kernel that assumes a layout invariant. that would explain trtllm-only behavior.
leo: note: TRT-LLM plugin 0.9.3 includes an optimization for packing KV for FP8/quant paths; shader path might read a stale layout when fallback to vllm codepath happens.
samuel: adding the tiny reproduction script to root of repo, but quick diff below of where crash happens:
```
// trtllm_plugin.cu: around copy_kv_to_cache
size_t dst_idx = compute_dst(kv_idx, batch_id, seq_pos);
// dst_idx sometimes equals MAX_KV_SLOTS when seq_pos wraps due to an off-by-one in compute_dst when AWQ packs per-channel scale
```
cheng: short-term workaround suggestions?
maria: can you (a) force use_vllm_fallback=false in serving config (avoids the path) or (b) downgrade to plugin 0.9.1 / CUDA20. both worked in my quick smoke.
leo: filed an internal issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-9421 referencing logs + minimal repro.
infra-bot: CI: perf-bakeoff job 4821 failed on linux-cuda21-trtllm (see logs) :x:
deploy-bot: deploy blocked for trtllm plugin upgrade until INF-9421 is resolved.
cheng: for the accuracy regression we should run a controlled eval: AWQ vs GPTQ serialized outputs at token-level for 500 eval prompts with trtllm. if token distributions differ only in trailing softmax precision we can tune quant params.
nisha: I'll kick off a 500-prompt eval run on dedicated pool and log token-level diffs. will post csv. :memo:
samuel: FYI I reproduced locally with smaller model (ceres-7b) and saw the assert too — seems general but threshold depends on seq-len.
maria: long-term: ask plugin team to add robust layout validation and bounds checks and make packing explicit for quant schemes. also suggest adding a tune flag to AWQ packer to emit trtllm-compatible layout.
leo: propose a quick test matrix: 
- CUDA20 + plugin 0.9.1 (baseline)
- CUDA21 + plugin 0.9.3 (fail)
- CUDA21 + plugin 0.9.3 + TRTLIM_DISABLE_KERNEL_FUSION=1 (no panic, ppl reg persists)
- CUDA21 + plugin 0.9.3 + use_vllm_fallback=false (no panic, check ppl)
we should run those on L40s and A100 to confirm.
cheng: thanks all. @nisha can you link the eval csv and I'll pair with infra next week to triage plugin bits?
nisha: will do. starting eval now, ETA ~3h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
leo: adding tag @plugin-team in INF-9421. :bug:
cheng: filing follow-up postmortem once we have eval numbers and plugin repro. want to avoid silent accuracy drift when switching quant runtime.
samuel: I'll attach the small repro and logs to the issue now. :white_check_mark:
